# Environment variables

<!-- Generated by `ocserve env-reference` from `crates/ocserve-core/src/env_contract.rs`.
Do not edit by hand: edit the contract, then run
`cargo run -q -p ocserve -- env-reference > docs/ENVIRONMENT.md`. -->

These are the variables the server reads. `ocserve doctor --env` prints the
same list and marks the ones set in your shell. Anything not listed here is
not read by the server; names like `OCSERVE_BIN` belong to repository
scripts and installers, not to the running service.

Where a knob also exists in `ocserve.toml`, the order is: command-line flag,
then environment, then file, then default.

A default written as `on` with `0 disables` is a kill switch: leave it unset
for the normal behaviour.

## Network and files

| Variable | Default | Accepted | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `OCSERVE_PORT` | 4096 | 1-65535 | Listen port. Precedence: --port, then ocserve.toml, then this, then 4096. |
| `OCSERVE_HOSTNAME` | 127.0.0.1 | an address | Bind address. Precedence: --hostname, then ocserve.toml, then this. |
| `OCSERVE_HOME` | HOME, then USERPROFILE | a directory | Overrides the home directory used for config/cache lookups (harnesses set it). |
| `OCSERVE_DATA_DIR` | ~/.local/share/ocserve | a directory | State directory: database, blobs, plugin host, snapshots. |
| `OCSERVE_CONFIG_WRITE` | shared | shared \| overlay | Where PATCH /config writes. `overlay` keeps ocserve out of the opencode config. |
| `OCSERVE_CORS` | (none) | origin[,origin...] | Extra allowed CORS origins, comma-separated. |

## Authentication

| Variable | Default | Accepted | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `OCSERVE_AUTH_MODE` | off | off \| basic | `basic` challenges every route, including SSE and /metrics. |
| `OCSERVE_AUTH_PASSWORD_FILE` | (none) | a file path | File holding the basic-auth password. Preferred over the env var. |
| `OCSERVE_SERVER_PASSWORD` | (none) | a password | Basic-auth password inline. Use the file so it stays out of the unit. |

## Prompts and providers

| Variable | Default | Accepted | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `OCSERVE_PROMPT_MAX_ROUNDS` | 0 (unlimited) | 0 = unlimited, else a count | Hard cap on model rounds per prompt. Exceeding it surfaces as a turn error. |
| `OCSERVE_PROMPT_MAX_COST_USD` | 0 (off) | 0 = off, else USD | Hard per-prompt spend ceiling. |
| `OCSERVE_PROMPT_HISTORY_UNBOUNDED` | off (bounded) | 0 \| 1 | 1 reads the whole session every turn instead of the proven suffix. Debug only; the sent messages are identical. |
| `OCSERVE_PROVIDER_STALL_SECS` | 120 | seconds | Stream-stall budget after the first real token. |
| `OCSERVE_PROVIDER_TTFB_SECS` | 300 | seconds | Budget for the first real token, covering gateway queueing. |
| `OCSERVE_ZEN_KEYLESS` | on | 0 disables | Install the keyless `Bearer public` endpoint for opencode free models. |
| `OCSERVE_CONTINUE_ON_DENY` | off (a deny stops the turn) | 1 enables | Keep the turn going after a denied tool call. |
| `OCSERVE_LOOP_GUARD` | on | 0 disables | Repeated/oscillating tool-call detection and its permission ask. |

## Plugins and MCP

| Variable | Default | Accepted | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `OCSERVE_PLUGIN_RUNTIME` | bun when installed, else node | bun \| node | Runtime for the plugin host. |
| `OCSERVE_PLUGIN_NORMALIZE` | on | 0 disables | Content-hash-cached plugin normalization before load. |
| `OCSERVE_PLUGIN_HEAP_MB` | 128 | MB | V8 heap cap for the Node plugin host. |
| `OCSERVE_PLUGIN_TOOLS` | on | 0 disables | Expose tools declared by plugins to the model. |
| `OCSERVE_HOOK_TIMEOUT_MS` | per hook: 60 s transform, 180 s tool, 300 s plugin tool | milliseconds; 0 = unbounded | One override for every hook budget. |
| `OCSERVE_MCP_TRUST` | observe | observe \| enforce | `enforce` drops flagged MCP tools and withholds their output. |

## Storage and memory

| Variable | Default | Accepted | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `OCSERVE_EVENT_RING_MB` | 32 | MB (min 1) | Byte budget for the shared SSE event ring. |
| `OCSERVE_BLOB_CACHE_MB` | 32 | MB | Byte budget for the blob-chunk read cache. |
| `OCSERVE_PAGE_MEMO` | on | 0 disables | Paged-message response cache. |
| `OCSERVE_PAGE_MEMO_MB` | 64 (clamped to 64) | MB | Total budget for the paged-message cache. |
| `OCSERVE_LIST_MEMO` | on | 0 disables | Session-list wire cache. |
| `OCSERVE_SEARCH_MEMO` | on | 0 disables | Search result cache. |
| `OCSERVE_WIRE_CACHE` | on | 0 disables | Precomputed response bodies per write epoch. |
| `OCSERVE_TRIM` | on | 0 disables | Periodic heap trim (returns freed pages to the OS). |
| `OCSERVE_TRIM_SECS` | 300 | seconds; 0 disables | Interval between heap trims. |

## Cgroups and lifecycle

| Variable | Default | Accepted | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `OCSERVE_CGROUP_PARTITION` | auto (only under systemd) | 0 \| 1 \| unset | Kids/ cgroup partition for child processes. |
| `OCSERVE_KIDS_CGROUP` | (internal) | a cgroup directory | Set by the partition dance for child processes; do not set it yourself. |
| `OCSERVE_KIDS_MEMORY_MAX_MB` | 700 | 32-1048576 | Aggregate memory cap for the kids/ cgroup. |
| `OCSERVE_SIDECAR_RECYCLE_MB` | 280 | MB; 0 disables | Plugin-host RSS that triggers a graceful restart of the host. |
| `OCSERVE_DRAIN_SECS` | 20 | seconds; 0 = forever | Shutdown drain deadline. |

## Web UI

| Variable | Default | Accepted | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `OCSERVE_UI` | on | 0 disables | HTTP UI routes. Disabled returns a JSON 404 instead of the app. |
| `OCSERVE_UI_PACK` | 1.18.31 | 1.18.31 \| 2.0.28 | Which embedded web-UI build is served. |
| `OCSERVE_DISABLE_EMBEDDED_WEB_UI` | off (embedded build served) | 1 disables | Serve through OCSERVE_UI_UPSTREAM instead of the embedded build. |
| `OCSERVE_UI_UPSTREAM` | https://app.opencode.ai | a URL | Proxy target used only when the embedded UI is disabled. |
| `OCSERVE_UI_PREWARM` | off | 1 enables | Fetch the entry HTML's assets at boot. |

## Config, sync and platform

| Variable | Default | Accepted | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `OCSERVE_V2` | off | 1 enables | The 96 v2-only operations (opencode 2 engine and routes). |
| `OCSERVE_CONFIG_WATCH` | on | 0 disables | Config hot-reload poller. |
| `OCSERVE_CONFIG_POLL_MS` | 2000 | milliseconds (min 100) | Config poll interval. |
| `OCSERVE_LEGACY_SYNC` | on | 0 disables | Legacy opencode to ocserve delta bridge. |
| `OCSERVE_LEGACY_DB` | ~/.local/share/opencode/opencode.db | a file path | Source database for the delta bridge. |
| `OCSERVE_SNAPSHOT` | on | 0 disables | File snapshots for revert and session diff. |
| `OCSERVE_REQ_LOG` | off | 1 enables | Log every request line. Loud, for debugging only. |
| `OCSERVE_SIFT` | off | unset/0 \| auto \| /path/to/sift | Bash-output compression at the provider boundary. |
| `OCSERVE_SIFT_TIMEOUT_MS` | 2000 | milliseconds (min 50) | Budget for one sift compression. |
| `OCSERVE_SHELL` | platform default | a program | Force the shell used by the bash tool. |
| `OCSERVE_SHELL_KIND` | detected | posix \| cmd \| pwsh | Force the shell family. |

## Harness only

| Variable | Default | Accepted | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `OCSERVE_CORPUS` | testdata/golden | (harness) | Replay corpus directory. |
| `OCSERVE_CORPUS_DB` | (none) | (harness) | Database for the bounded-load corpus probe. |
| `OCSERVE_CORPUS_SESSION` | (none) | (harness) | Session for the bounded-load corpus probe. |
| `OCSERVE_PAIR_ALLOW` | (none) | (harness) | Pair-check allowlist path. |
| `OCSERVE_SA_TIMING_DB` | (none) | (harness) | Disposable database for the migration timing probe. |
| `OCSERVE_TEST_BIND_DELAY_MS` | (none) | (harness) | Debug-build bind delay for shutdown-race tests. |
| `OCSERVE_VERSION` | the crate version | (harness) | Set by the server for the plugin host (`ctx.app.version`). |
| `OCSERVE_BUILD_COMMIT` | build.rs | (harness) | Embedded revision stamp for release builds. |

## Upstream opencode flags honoured

These are opencode's variables, not ours; ocserve reads them the same way
upstream does.

| Variable | Effect |
|---|---|
| `OPENCODE_ENABLE_EXPERIMENTAL_MODELS` | Serve `alpha` models. `deprecated` models are never served. |
| `OPENCODE_API_KEY` | Key for the `opencode` provider (takes precedence over the keyless free tier). |
| `OPENCODE_MODELS_URL` / `OPENCODE_MODELS_PATH` | Catalog source and cache path (same as upstream). |
| `OPENCODE_DISABLE_MODELS_FETCH` | Disable catalog refresh. |
